experience.title: Mid/Senior Full-Stack Developer
experience.summary: At Movida, I led the modernization of a legacy contract management system, building the front end with Angular 16 and micro frontends, while integrating .NET 8 and C# APIs to deliver new features. I applied RxJS and NgRx to improve state consistency and performance, and used Docker to standardize development and deployment environments. In close collaboration with the product team, I took a data-driven approach to optimize the user experience, reducing rework and increasing adoption among internal users. I also maintained a CI/CD pipeline with Jenkins, ensuring frequent releases supported by automated TypeScript/Jest tests and validation of JWT-protected REST endpoints.

experience.title: Mid-Level Full-Stack Developer
experience.summary: I restructured a monolithic application into a microservices architecture, exposing secure RESTful APIs with JWT authentication and implementing automated tests with Jest to improve reliability. I developed services using NestJS and PostgreSQL/TypeORM and containerized components with Docker, which accelerated the delivery cycle and simplified observability and maintenance. The new service topology reduced deployment time and facilitated BI integrations; Jenkins-based CI/CD pipelines ensured consistent versioning and automated checks in TypeScript and JavaScript, aligned with clean code practices and service integration standards.

experience.title: Full-Stack Developer
experience.summary: I maintained and enhanced internal applications built with PHP and Laravel, using Vue.js and MySQL, and refactored the billing module for asynchronous processing with Redis queues, reducing average report generation time by more than 70%. I structured REST endpoints and standardized contracts to simplify consumption by JavaScript/TypeScript and React front ends when needed. I also introduced automated testing practices and a continuous integration pipeline with Jenkins, along with Docker-based containerization for eligible services, improving deployment predictability and production stability.

experience.title: Full-Stack Web Developer
experience.summary: I worked with small businesses to build custom systems using React and Next.js integrated with external APIs, leveraging MongoDB whenever data flexibility was a priority. In a delivery project, I implemented geolocation with real-time updates and REST integrations, ensuring strong front-end performance in JavaScript/TypeScript and a robust backend. I maintained a strong focus on performance and consistent delivery, using Docker in development environments and applying version control best practices, while also drawing on prior experience with Angular and variations such as micro frontends whenever required.
